decision_scope: Draft for the pilot path of ADR-049 (2026-11-05). Keeps the ADR-011/013/014 deletion and backup limits of v4 and adds the data the product now handles: the seller's text for each photo (ADR-050), CSV tables (ADR-040), OpenAI processing through the operator's n8n (ADR-045/046) and private catalogue PDF and story files (ADR-052/053). Category limits, implementation evidence and final approval are pending; open owner decisions are listed in docs/PILOT_DATA_POLICY_v1.0.md.

deletion.clock: Verified owner request recorded after re-authentication (T0); receipts, retries and workers do not restart it.
deletion.post_request_backup_rule: Every recoverable copy containing the account data expires by min(its ordinary age limit, T0 + 7 days); the live purge delay plus the database backup age must stay within 168 hours; copying, retries and the live cleanup target do not extend this deadline.
deletion.completion_rule: No personal data or recoverable keys in controlled live systems, processors or backups before marking complete. No retained personal deletion-history copy.
deletion.priority: Verified erasure request overrides ordinary retention; notify the user of a substantiated legal conflict instead of claiming complete erasure.
